about: Batch 7a (fix/batch7a): the output changes made on purpose, compared with a3e535e by `bash scripts/golden-check.sh a3e535e full --expect tests/golden_expect/batch7a.json --items m9`. MASK_VERSION 8 -> 9 (PR2 Codex round 4, high 1: a serialized key block's END read at its escape level) re-masks every approved copy and the engine cache; the golden boxes hold no key blocks, PGP packets or long connector answers, so highs 1-4 change nothing else. The entries are batch6b.json's kl3 ones (same scenarios, keys and checks) with the version 8 -> 9.

entries.why: MASK_VERSION 8 -> 9 (batch 7a, round 4 high 1): the marker says every approved copy was masked again by version 9; the exact transition, both lines in that order and nothing else

MASK_VERSION 8 -> 9: each approved copy is re-masked and records version 9; the copy is parsed and must be exactly the same apart from that field (no copy's text may change), in every copy of every scenario named (the scenarios with approved copies: not the empty account, crash or tierC)
MASK_VERSION 8 -> 9: every engine cache entry is re-masked and records version 9, nothing else changes (one entry left at 8 is no match)
